warnings: The three waves use period-specific county polygons. Repeated county names do not establish unchanged geography, and the product reports no cross-wave county change statistic.
The 2021 values are survey estimates published in tens. Source-unavailable minor religion cells remain null in raw data and are never imputed.
The 2000 age-15-plus universe also includes persons whose age was unknown, as stated in the source footnote.
validation.notes: All three waves are present with 15 county rows. Headline values are complete. The 2000 and 2011 complete county category sums reconcile exactly to the published national rows. The 2021 discrepancies remain within the source's documented rounding behaviour; published counts are unchanged. All three boundary outputs contain 15 valid, non-empty, distinctly hashed geometries.

2021.geography_reconciliation_bound_derivatio: Each of the 15 county cells summed into a category's national total is independently rounded to the nearest ten (maximum rounding error 5 per cell); the bound is 5 x 15 = 75. The observed maximum absolute difference is 30.
2021.affiliation_child_reconciliation_bound_d: Each of the 16 published affiliation child categories summed within a geography row is independently rounded to the nearest ten (maximum rounding error 5 per cell); the bound is 5 x 16 = 80. The observed maximum absolute difference across complete county rows is 20.
2021.rounding_treatment: Statistics Estonia publishes values in multiples of ten and states that aggregated values may differ from sums because of rounding. Published counts remain unchanged; no residual is distributed.

construct_notes: Indicator declaration: self-reported census religious affiliation among the population aged 15 and over.
Every denominator is the published population aged 15 and over in the same county and wave. Total population is never used.

The 2021 religion characteristic comes from the census sample survey and is generalised to the full population aged 15 and over. Religion itself is not register-supplemented. Published counts remain rounded to tens.
The 2000 no-religion headline is Has no religious affiliation plus Atheist. The 2011 and 2021 headlines use Does not feel an affiliation to any religion.
Refused, cannot define, and relationship-unknown categories remain in the age-15-plus denominator and outside both headline numerators.

The product uses official county geography for each wave. Statistics Estonia does not publish these earlier religion tables rebased to current counties or municipalities, and the build creates no concordance.
